svg.title: TRACE-GC end-to-end workflow
svg.desc: Source records and reviewed evidence enter immutable graph compilation, retrieval, semantic observation, joint resolution, policy and authenticated publication; graph history supplies cited retrieval and future runs. Experimental PDF review is an explicit application handoff.
